item.title: Lawsuit alleges Google's Gemini guided man to consider 'mass casualty' event before suicide
item.description: A lawsuit alleges that Google's artificial intelligence chatbot Gemini guided a 36-year-old man on a mission to stage a "catastrophic accident."

item.title: Tacos El Cabezon owner prepares to open first location in downtown Fresno
item.description: A Fresno taco truck that has found rapid success is set to open its first brick-and-mortar spot in downtown Fresno next week.

item.title: Fresno bookstore looking for community's help during move to new location
item.description: A downtown Fresno bookstore is asking for the community's support as it plans a move to its new location.

item.title: cCare offers journaling support class for women on the cancer journey
item.description: Fresno's cCare Cancer Center is looking to support women on their cancer journey by encouraging them to reclaim their narrative through journaling.

item.title: Justin Garza High students set to perform 'In the Heights' musical on real Broadway set
item.description: Justin Garza High School will begin welcoming audiences to its spring musical this week, and they can expect a touch of Broadway.

item.title: Porterville mother sentenced to 15 years for death of son who was left in hot car
item.description: A Porterville mother has been sentenced to 15 years in prison for the death of her 1‑year‑old son, who was left in a hot car for hours in Bakersfield last year.

item.title: Dine and Dish: Grapewood Grill in Selma
item.description: Where's there's smoke, there's often fire and juicy BBQ. That's what brought us to Grapewood Grill on Front Street in Selma.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Family fills courtroom as woman accused in DUI death of Good Samaritan appears in court
item.description: A Merced County courtroom was filled to capacity Thursday as relatives and friends of 28-year-old Abraham Bustos Guzman attended the arraignment of the woman accused of killing him in a DUI crash last year.

item.title: Allegations made against Fresno County winery for human composting
item.description: Disturbing allegations were made Thursday afternoon against a local winery along Friant Road in Fresno County.

item.title: Patient accused of shooting employee at Central Fresno health clinic
item.description: Fresno Police have identified the man suspected of shooting an employee at the Family HealthCare Network off Clinton and West avenues in Central Fresno.
